After the values are restored, move the postcode into the separate postcode box in B08 and B18 if it is included in the restored address. Otherwise, enter the Manchester postcode by hand. If B07 requires a different date format, reformat the restored date by hand.

The property manager or owner should specify the submission methods in B03 and the requested documents in B15–B17. If your wife is also applying as a co-applicant, the form says she needs her own copy.
